records.name: Soulrest
records.held_by: A merchant council, the ex-Imperial civil office and river interests, in an unresolved contest; the Banujha tribes hold the hatching grounds
records.summary: Soulrest is Black Marsh's Third Era capital and its only city on the Topal Bay and Southern Sea corner, a port with no empire left to serve. Its government quarter is half empty, the mixed population lives off sea trade, salvage and the hidden Bramman's river, and three groups contest who rules.

notes.text: The southwest coast port on a peninsula wrapping Topal Bay, capital of Black Marsh in the Third Era. In 4E 201 it is an administrative city with nothing left to administer, and the most mixed and contested city in the province.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: Argonians lived here since the wraxu birds were alive. Red Bramman ran pirates from a mangrove river nearby in 1E; the Great Burn (1E 2828) reached its edge; the tribes burned its plantations and mines in 3E 427, ending gold and timber exports. The Empire left after the 4E 48 catastrophe.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: A merchant council, the ex-Imperial civil apparatus with no sovereign, the mangrove-river interests and the interior mine-burning tribes contest the city, the unexplained 'struggle for regional hegemony' of canon. The government quarter is half empty and repurposed. The city has no Hist, so its Argonians hatch, name and bury inland in Banujha country.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: About 60% Argonian, a large Khajiit share among seafarers, Imperial-descended administrators' families, Bosmer and other maritime minorities. A few dozen named residents at Skyrim's scale.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: Southern Sea trade, salvage from wrecks off the cape, and Bramman's river, the concealed channel from Topal Bay to the Blackrose lakes. Gold and timber are no longer exported at scale; the old workings behind the city are derelict.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: Sithis and the Hist through the interior tribes' trees; Imperial-descended families keep the Nine in small shrines; Khajiit sailors keep the moons. A Brotherhood of Seth presence is canon and stays hidden.

sources.title: metropolis on Cape Percar, umber culture, Soulrest 4E 201 state

notes.text: A port behind its gates where the sea's noise drops away: stone Imperial quarter at the peninsula's neck, timber and stilt wharves below, mangrove creeks to the south, xanmeers etched with wraxu, and burn-scarred dead ground and gas vents on its landward edge.

notes.text: Inside the gates guards keep order; threats are theft, smugglers' feuds and a visitor carrying the wrong cargo. The landward burn-scar is gas and dead timber; the inland tribes are hostile to coast officials.

records.name: Blackrose
records.held_by: The island core: a narrow, defensive, self-perpetuating government whose legitimacy is possession
records.summary: Blackrose is a lake-island city where three rivers meet, ringed by stilt districts and boardwalks over the water. It is the hinge of the south, taxing everything that moves between Murkwood, Oliis Bay, eastern Blackwood and Bramman's river. Its people are the oddest mix in the province and trust no institution.

notes.text: A major city in a lake in south-central Black Marsh where three rivers converge. The Rose lies off in the marsh and is not the city's, though outsiders assume it is.

sources.title: large city in the Tulmek Washes, olive culture, Blackrose 4E 201 state

notes.text: Built by the Lilmothiit; Kothringi and Yespest lived nearby. Red Bramman's bandit kingdom stood here around 1E 1033. The Imperial rebuild followed 1E 2837; the 2E rumoured it ruined; the city raised an army against the Third Empire and was broken by the battlemage Welloc's vampiric cloud.

sources.title: large city in the Tulmek Washes, olive culture, Blackrose 4E 201 state

notes.text: Functioning but diminished, with ruined and rebuilt quarters of several ages and old siege earthworks in the marsh from Welloc's campaign. The island core holds the toll and the hatching. Its Hist lies drowned in the lake, reached only by boat and dive.

sources.title: large city in the Tulmek Washes, olive culture, Blackrose 4E 201 state

notes.text: Argonian-majority, with prison staff families, ex-prisoners, deserters, refugees and coerced migrants. Distrust of battlemages and of the Rose runs through all of them.
